statements.status_notes: The image replaces Lib/html/parser.py with official CPython backport commit 7933f4bf7131aa4140750f9404f5de0aa2969ced after SHA-256 verification and executes the upstream regression probe during the build.

The image replaces Lib/tarfile.py with official CPython 3.13 backport commit 9c17bace90f88dfba6d0e2fe23c8e7ae35f83955 after SHA-256 verification and asserts the hardened hardlink fallback during the build.

The image replaces Lib/tarfile.py with official CPython 3.13 backport commit 9c17bace90f88dfba6d0e2fe23c8e7ae35f83955 after SHA-256 verification and asserts streaming seek terminates at EOF during the build.

The image installs the unmodified CPython 3.13 security backport at 9c17bace90f88dfba6d0e2fe23c8e7ae35f83955 after verifying SHA-256 0fd87b49826f745c16e3ee68b2390a206b2dfcfe9a0b1118bd7fcd7c06deaff1. The build runs scripts/verify_cpython_tarfile.py against the installed standard library; both data and tar filters must prevent hardlink relocation of a relative symlink and protect a file outside the extraction root.

statements.impact_statement: The FFmpeg libraries are transitive OpenCV wheel components. The OCR boundary only accepts strictly preflighted PNG, JPEG, TIFF and PDF documents; video and audio containers, streams and codecs are rejected before inference.
Only validated still-image and PDF OCR paths are reachable; FFmpeg video and audio decoding paths are not exposed.
